rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=param_efficient-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=PUSH THE DOMINANT LEVER at 0.09 — extend the gentle Manduca PROJECTION filter to a MULTI-SCALE PARALLEL bank on top of the iter-31 champion (FoE + single-scale Manduca + anisotropic, val hr 0.3968 @ 1,929p). [PRIOR: FoE+Manduca 0.394 = the DOMINANT complementary bias (+0.048 over bilateral); +anisotropic 0.3968; isotropic image bilateral on Manduca REDUNDANT (iter-30 0.381).] FAILURE MODE addressed: the Manduca proj filter had ONE spatial scale; one projection bandwidth cannot both smooth broad streaks AND preserve fine ray structure. CHANGE (ONE knob): proj_multiscale=True, proj_n_bf=3, per-filter init sigma [0.83,1.66,3.32]px (x2 octave ladder, first==iter-31), each parallel projection bilateral on the SAME sqrt-count Q with its OWN ZERO-INIT gain => out=P+SUM_i gain_i*(Phat_i-P). FoE+anisotropic+the single existing Manduca scale all intact. PARAMS: FoE 1920 + alpha 1 + aniso 3 + proj(3*3 sigma + 1 logN0 + 3 gains = 13) = 1937 (+8 over iter-31, <<233k). ZERO-INIT: all proj gains=0 => ||sino_filtered-sino||=0 => pipeline==iter-31 byte-for-byte (worst case ==0.3968, no regression); runtime self-check asserts it. GENTLENESS: each added proj scale gentle (zero-init gain, soft range sigma); lever is STRENGTH not edge-hardness. DENSE-VIEW CAVEAT: 2304 views => FBP already averages much proj noise => small gain or clean null, maps the Manduca ceiling. HYPOTHESIS: more projection scales add headroom => hr>0.3968; NULL = only the 0.83 scale gain stays nonzero (hr~0.3968) => one proj scale suffices. peak lr 5e-3, partial cosine T_max=16, K=5 tied, mu>=0 only, max_train_s=1080. PREDICTED hr ~0.397-0.41.
